name: Russia-Ukraine Conflict & Global Commodity Shock
description: Full-scale military conflict triggering sweeping Western sanctions, exclusion of major Russian banks from SWIFT, crude oil spiking past $130/barrel, and severe European natural gas rationing.

headlines.text: Russian military forces launch major multi-front offensive into Ukraine; Brent crude oil surges above $105 per barrel for the first time since 2014.
US, European Commission, and UK agree to sever selected Russian financial institutions from the SWIFT international banking messaging network.
Western allies freeze foreign exchange reserves of the Central Bank of Russia; Russian Ruble crashes 30% to historic low amidst domestic bank runs.
Wheat, fertilizer, and agricultural grain futures touch all-time record highs amidst Black Sea maritime port blockades and export disruptions.
United States bans all imports of Russian oil, liquefied natural gas, and coal; Brent crude spikes to $139 per barrel as European gas prices hit record peaks.
